rows.title: Kilmor's Testament
rows.text: Kilmor's defeat, capture, the Pens, mesmerist attempts to Hollow him, his refusal. The account is kept for travelers of the Cradle Plateau. Read it before leaving the post, and weigh its warnings against the reports brought home by other expeditions. What is learned here may guide the next journey; it promises no safety beyond these walls.

rows.title: News of the Long War
rows.text: News from the Long War: Lord Wood holds a northern camp against Voss. His officers gather among supply tents and field surgeries. Folios and dispatches describe the struggle; the expedition must seek his audience while its reputation remains clean. A duel of wills may hold Voss long enough for others to strike.

rows.title: The Master Bowyers
rows.text: The elder sun-cult's armorer-saint taught the mesa bowyers. Elder masters endow their works with true virtues, and give those works to the proven. Patience matters more than violence in the bowyer's challenge: carry an egg away without striking the viper or being struck. Learn which scent repels and which attracts.

rows.title: The Twin Cities
rows.text: The five tiers are Province, Sun-Ziggurat, Drowned Ziggurat, Ember Deeps, and Séance Tribunal. Elder transit is the only door between them. The twin cities once shared mirrored splendor; exile divided their people. Their halls still reflect one another. A traveler who remembers the steps of one city may understand the other.
